title: Taichung — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Taichung: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Taichung has a population of 2,820,000. The third-largest city in Taiwan, known for its cultural festivals, parks, and as a center for manufacturing. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 89 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.

Last updated: November 07, 2026
